import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class Codechef {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.nextLine();
        String len = sc.nextLine();
        ArrayList<String> in = new ArrayList<>();
        int i = 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        int j = 0;
        int maxl = 0;
        while (i < str.lastIndexOf(')')) {
            String s = str.substring(j, str.indexOf('(', i));
            StringTokenizer sto = new StringTokenizer(s, "_");
            while (sto.hasMoreTokens()) {
                int l = sto.nextToken().length();
                if (l > maxl)
                    maxl = l;
            }
            j = str.indexOf(')', j + 1) + 1;
            String inside = str.substring(str.indexOf('(', i) + 1, str.indexOf(')', i + 1));
            StringTokenizer sti = new StringTokenizer(inside, "_");
            while (sti.hasMoreTokens()) {
                if (sti.nextToken() != "")
                    cnt++;
            }
            i = str.indexOf(')', i + 1);
        }
        String s = str.substring(j);
        StringTokenizer sto = new StringTokenizer(s, "_");
        while (sto.hasMoreTokens()) {
            int l = sto.nextToken().length();
            if (l > maxl)
                maxl = l;
        }
        System.out.println(maxl + " " + cnt);
    }
}
